recall.answer: Shells 0-1 live in items 1-2, shells 2-3 in items 3-6, shell 4 in item 7, shell 5 in item 8, shell 6 in item 9, shell 7 in item 11, shell 8 in item 10, shell 9 in item 12, shell 10 in item 13(c). Item 13 checks the depth gate.

recall.question: Why is 'latest' forbidden as a dataset pointer?
recall.answer: Models must point at immutable versioned snapshots with manifests. 'Latest' is a moving target that destroys reproducibility.

recall.question: What decides what the model learns as 'one context'?
recall.answer: The document boundary. Packing later concatenates documents, and attention must not cross the boundary, or the model learns spurious long-range links.

recall.question: What are the three corrupted-record classes and their policies?
recall.answer: Truncated: drop or keep-with-flag. Bad encoding: re-decode or drop. Empty: drop. Silent keeping is the failure mode.
